investigations.summary: PMM-T2357: on busy sharded-PSMDB services (>25 RTA rows) the RTA elapsed-time Min field, table filter and URL desync, so a cleared bound stays in the URL; reproduced 3/3 on fresh 3-dev-latest, passes on single-RS setups.
PMM-T2227 tarball upgrade hit the default 120 s test timeout while downloading/installing the released client tarball; covered by open PR #1572 (raises it to 20 min).

client 3.7.1 lane: pmm3-aws-staging-start #27023 missed its 100 s readyz budget on a slow EC2 host (image pull 2m01s vs 35s on siblings, Grafana first-start migrations 73 s); 24 sibling starts that night and the previous 30 builds passed.
